decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, garden room and vehicular crossover to the existing dwelling, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwelling, the character of the Conservation Area or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the vehicular access hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until screen planting along the southeastern ad southwestern boundaries have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the commencement of development details of the proposed garden room's foundations shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The development of the foundations shall be in accordance with the details approved by the Local Planning Authority under condition 6.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, outbuilding for use as store / conservatory and the creation of vehicular hardstanding to front forecourt of existing dwellinghouse
